name: 骑射横扫
description: 获得动能。选择一个正方向上7格内的一个空格并向其冲刺，对路径上敌人造成100%攻击力的物理伤害。动能5：弹射物。冲刺后选择一个垂直于冲刺方向的方向，对路径上每格往该方向4格范围内的所有敌人造成5点伤害，可穿透角色。动能7：路径伤害+2。
code: function executeSkill(context){var c=context.piece,b=context.battle,core=(c.statusTags||[]).find(function(t){return t.type==='momentum-core';}),momentum=core?Number(core.stacks||0):Number(c.momentum||0),pos=selectTarget({type:'grid',range:7,filter:'all'});if(!pos||pos.needsTargetSelection)return pos;var dx=Math.sign(pos.x-c.x),dy=Math.sign(pos.y-c.y),steps=Math.max(Math.abs(pos.x-c.x),Math.abs(pos.y-c.y));if((dx===0&&dy===0)||(dx!==0&&dy!==0)||steps>7)return {success:false,message:'请选择7格内上下左右方向'};var last=null,pathHit=[],pathCells=[];for(var i=1;i<=steps;i++){var x=c.x+dx*i,y=c.y+dy*i,tile=b.map.tiles.find(function(q){return q.x===x&&q.y===y;});if(!tile||!tile.props||tile.props.walkable===false||tile.props.type==='wall'||tile.props.type==='trap'||tile.props.type==='hole')return {success:false,message:'冲刺路径被墙体、陷阱或不可通行地形阻挡'};pathCells.push({x:x,y:y});if(!b.pieces.some(function(p){return p.currentHp>0&&p.x===x&&p.y===y&&p.instanceId!==c.instanceId;}))last={x:x,y:y};var pathVictims=b.pieces.filter(function(p){return p.currentHp>0&&p.ownerPlayerId!==c.ownerPlayerId&&p.x===x&&p.y===y;});pathVictims.forEach(function(p){var r=dealDamage(c,p,c.attack+(momentum>=7?2:0),'physical',b,context.skill.id);pathHit.push(p.name+'(-'+r.damage+')');});}if(!last)return {success:false,message:'没有可落脚的空格'};if(momentum>=5){c.statusTags=c.statusTags||[];c.statusTags.push({id:'shadow-ride-sweep-side-'+c.instanceId+'-'+Date.now(),type:'shadow-ride-sweep-side',name:'骑射横扫侧射',pathCells:pathCells,dx:dx,dy:dy,left:{x:pos.x+dy,y:pos.y-dx},right:{x:pos.x-dy,y:pos.y+dx},currentDuration:0,currentUses:1,visible:false});}var preserved=(c.statusTags||[]).some(function(t){return t.type==='preserve-momentum';}),nextMomentum=(preserved?momentum:0)+pathCells.length;c.x=last.x;c.y=last.y;if(core)core.stacks=nextMomentum;c.momentum=nextMomentum;return {success:true,message:'骑射横扫至('+last.x+','+last.y+')'+(pathHit.length?'，路径命中'+pathHit.join('、'):'')};}
